method: Static gravity projection at the seat, rigid sweep of the whole seated pipe from its carry seat toward each opening against every other reserve, and the free-piece receive, receive-and-go and sled trials (evidence/field-trials.json: stick-slip friction, so a seated pipe holds statically) for dynamic capture, power loss and the isolation of each retaining member.

pushBack: lower and upper treads under the powered hold (front)
check flap and its rear stop (rear)
side walls 10.2 mm from the pipe ends (+/-Y)

forward (+X) into the nip.note: no rigid obstruction within 400 mm: the rigid roller cores clear the pipe through the throat; the forward stop is the compliant tread squeeze under the powered hold, qualified by the receive and sled trials

powerOff.holder: The tread squeeze: to leave forward the pipe must climb the 12 mm squeeze, which needs no power. The 36:1 gearbox is back-drivable and adds only its reflected inertia; brake idle mode adds damping while the controller is powered. Rearward the check flap's stop holds.
powerOff.summary: With the main power off the gearbox coasts and the pipe is held by the tread squeeze: 24/24 required cases retained over 40-160 N/mm (a 1.5 g stop for 0.5 s and an 8 g, 50 ms hit, main power off and brake idle mode), largest travel into the nip 3.79 mm. At 40 N/mm with the power off: sustained 6 g kept, 8 g lost; 50 ms hit 16 g kept, 24 g lost. Static push-through 71.8 N at 40 N/mm against a 14.2 N stop load. Control: rollers decoupled on a 20 N/mm tread lose the pipe at 8 g.
powerOff.controlRequirement: Handoff requirement: the nip motor controller's idle mode is brake, so the windings are shorted whenever the robot is disabled with the controller powered. Coast idle mode is not accepted. Brake idle mode is not credited with the breaker off, where the squeeze alone holds.
powerOff.requiredBasis: A robot that is not driving stops no harder than its tyres grip: 1.5 g for 0.5 s covers a friction coefficient up to 1.5 and a stop from 4.5 m/s (0.31 s). A hit from another robot is the G3 pulse, 8 g for 50 ms (2.5 m/s change of chassis speed).

escapeControl.result: check flap removed: 8 g toward the inlet from a gently settled seat 1/2 retained; receive and go 0/2 retained
escapeControl.firstOpening: rearward up the floor toward the inlet

isolation.drive: Powered hold: 108/108 receives seat over 40-160 N/mm. Robot disabled: 4/4 receives seat and 18/18 sled pulses are retained. The the first draft worm lock seats 4/4: the lock adds nothing the powered hold and the gearbox do not give.
isolation.flap: No flap from the received seat: 1 g 2/2, 3 g 2/2, 8 g 1/2; from a gently settled seat: 1 g 2/2, 3 g 2/2, 8 g 1/2; receive and go without it: 0/2 retained
isolation.hood: No hood: 4/4 receives seat; no flare: 4/4; peak rise with both 7.93 mm. Not shown to earn their place in the planar model.
isolation.tread: 10 N/mm: 7/12 receives seat; 20 N/mm 11/12; 30 N/mm 12/12; 40-160 N/mm 108/108 with tread mu 0.3-1.0.

findings.text: Tread stiffness decides receive custody: fails at 10 N/mm, 11/12 at 20 N/mm, all pass from 30 N/mm, accepted band 40-120 N/mm per roller. No supplier publishes it; G0 measures the installed stack and sets the wheel count.
Carry custody rests on the flap for rearward loads and the powered hold and squeeze for forward loads; model: 72/72 powered and 18/18 disabled sled cases retained at 1-8 g.
